name: menteion-specs
description: Documentation verification for Menteion: executable architecture assertions (spec-guard), cross-document consistency (spec-graph), and the briefs' contract and archive (spec-brief). The engine itself is a Rust workspace; see Cargo.toml.

scripts.spec: npm run spec:guard && npm run spec:prove && npm run spec:graph && npm run spec:briefs && npm run spec:archive && npm run spec:archive:test && npm run spec:scope && npm run spec:scope:test && npm run spec:explorations && npm run spec:explorations:test && npm run spec:decisions && npm run spec:decisions:test && npm run spec:index && npm run spec:index:test && npm run spec:shape && npm run spec:shape:test && npm run spec:version && npm run spec:version:test && npm run spec:scripts:test && npm run spec:deps && npm run spec:costs && npm run spec:costs:test && npm run mutants:timeouts:test && npm run round:additive:test
